hints.title: Base 10 Accumulation
hints.text: Process digits from left to right, shifting the current accumulated value by a factor of ten before adding the next digit.

hints.title: Iterative Transition
hints.text: Initialize value to zero. At each digit d, update value = value * 10 + d.

hints.title: Overflow Guard
hints.text: Ensure 64-bit integer variables are used if the resulting magnitude exceeds standard 32-bit limits.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of digits in array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting to string and parsing introduces unnecessary memory allocations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space suffices with arithmetic updates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Direct arithmetic accumulation without string conversion libraries.
